statement: Linux requests DualSense feature 0x05 with 41-byte calibration payload and interprets gyro bias/plus-minus values and accelerometer calibration into Linux sensor-scale correction; a failed read is an initialization error.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 1023-1105; host parsing not independent calibration of physical gyro.
